headline: Northern Fronts Hemorrhage Troops as Weathered Expanse and Callahan's Passage Reel
war_summary: Fighting across the northern theater has intensified to fever pitch, with catastrophic butcher's bills and shifting lines across several contested sectors. In Weathered Expanse, where over 3,700 soldiers fell in the last two hours alone—including more than 2,400 Warden casualties—a fourth strategic base has been reduced to no-man's-land as Colonial holdings slipped to four. To the west, Callahan's Passage witnessed a savage clash claiming over 3,300 combined casualties in two hours; Warden forces have consolidated all ten regional bases, fighting off incursions around The Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post. Nevish Line flared with six base events in the past two hours, sustaining heavy exchanges exceeding 1,600 casualties while Wardens maintain a 7–1 base advantage. In Mooring County, rapid territory turnover paused over the past two hours, though severe grinding combat generated over 1,100 casualties as Colonials defend two footholds. Elsewhere, fresh fighting erupted in Gutter with six quick transitions at Kuoppa before Wardens restored full control, and Marban Hollow registered a Warden seizure of Mox.
